step2.title: Connect your ABHA
step2.description: Use your ABHA details to identify yourself securely.
step2.demoInfo: This prototype uses fictional patient credentials.

step3.title: Before we begin
step3.description: Aayuvora will collect information about your current health concern to prepare you for your consultation.
step3.voice: You can speak naturally or answer using the screen.
step3.questions: Aayuvora may ask relevant follow-up questions.
step3.documents: You may provide relevant medical documents.

step4.title: AI Health Consultation
step4.greeting: Namaste. Please tell me what health concern brought you here today.
step4.personalGreeting: Namaste {{name}}. Please tell me what health concern brought you here today.
step4.temporary: This information is currently being held as a temporary session.
step4.aiFollowUp: Thank you. How long have you been experiencing this problem?

step5.title: Add Medical Documents
step5.description: Add a relevant prescription, lab report or discharge document.

step6.title: Aayuvora has prepared your summary
step6.reviewWarning: This is an AI-assisted draft. The doctor must review and verify the information.

step7.title: Doctor Review
step7.reviewNotice: Doctor review is required before final clinical decisions.

step8.title: Your information, your choice
step8.description: Your consultation is complete. Choose whether the consultation information should be retained according to the healthcare workflow.
step8.storeDescription: Retain permitted consultation information according to the authorized workflow.
step8.deleteDescription: Remove temporary conversation content after the session, subject to the applicable retention policy.
step8.privacy: Minimal technical or audit information may still be retained when required for security and operations.
step8.storedMessage: Your permitted consultation information has been retained according to the selected workflow.
step8.deletedMessage: The temporary consultation content has been cleared from the patient session.
